description: Save an already-uploaded object (from create_media_upload) to the media library and return a media id. Works for images and videos (mp4/mov/webm). Images can optionally be reformatted to a publishing format first: the server reads the upload back from storage, stores the reformatted image as a new file and deletes the raw upload at storageKey, which cannot be undone. Videos are always recorded as-is. Omit format (or use "original") to record it unchanged — recording as-is deletes nothing. Pass the SAME workspaceId you gave create_media_upload — a storage key belongs to the workspace it was minted in and is refused anywhere else.

crop.description: How a 'cover' crop chooses what to keep: 'smart' = saliency-based, keeps the subject (default); 'centre' = predictable middle crop, better for posters/screenshots

fit.description: cover = crop to fill (default), contain = fit + pad

format.description: Reformat to this before saving; omit to keep original

workspaceId.description: Which workspace to act in — an id from list_workspaces. Optional with a single workspace; REQUIRED once there are several, where guessing would mean posting one client's content to another client's accounts. Ask the user which one before publishing.

name: attach_media
title: Attach an uploaded file
